                        <td><a class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-primary btn-sm" href="act_not_audit.html">审核</a></td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
    }

    function loadActivities() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/findAuditActivityByState",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": page,
                "size": size,
                "keyword": keyword
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "待审核活动加载失败");
                    return;
                }
                renderActivityTable(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("待审核活动加载失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    function loadCounters() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/findAuditActivityByState",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": 1,
                "size": 1
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result && result.extend) {
                    $("#count_audit").text(result.extend.total || 0);
                }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 287 页
            },
            error: function () {
                $("#count_audit").text(0);
            }
        });
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/review/manualHours",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": 1,
                "size": 1,
                "state": "0"
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result && result.extend) {
                    $("#count_manual").text(result.extend.total || 0);
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                $("#count_manual").text(0);
            }
        });
    }

    $("#btn_search_activity").click(function () {
        keyword = $.trim($("#activity_keyword").val());
        page = 1;
        loadActivities();
    });

    $("#btn_reset_activity").click(function () {
        $("#activity_keyword").val("");
        keyword = "";
        page = 1;
        loadActivities();
    });

    $("#activity_keyword").keydown(function (event) {
        if (event.keyCode === 13) {
            $("#btn_search_activity").click();
        }
    });

    $("#btn_prev_page").click(function () {
        if (page > 1) {
            page = page - 1;
            loadActivities();
        }
    });

    $("#btn_next_page").click(function () {
        page = page + 1;
        loadActivities();
    });

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadCounters();
        loadActivities();
    });
</script>

    var page = 1;
    var size = 10;
    var keyword = "";
    var state = "";

    var currentCheckinNum = null;

    var reviewModal = null;

    var anomalyPage = 1;
    var anomalySize = 10;

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function reviewStateText(timecheck) {
        if (timecheck === "1") {
            return '<span class="badge badge-success">已确认</span>';
        }

    function renderPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {

    function renderManualHours(checkins) {
        var $body = $("#manual_table").empty();
        if (!checkins || checkins.length === 0) {
            $body.append('<tr><td colspan="9" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(checkins, function (index, checkin) {
            var pending = !checkin.checkinTimecheck;
            var action = pending
                ? `<button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                           onclick="openReview(${checkin.checkinNum})">复核</button>`
                : '<span class="text-muted">已处理</span>';
            html += `<tr>
                        <td>${checkin.volunteerName || "—"}
                            <span class="d-block text-muted small">${checkin.volunteerId || ""} ${checkin.volunteerTel || ""}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td>${checkin.activityName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${checkin.organizationName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(checkin.checkinBegintime)}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(checkin.checkinEndtime)}</td>
                        <td>${checkin.checkinDuration || 0}</td>
                        <td>${checkin.checkinRemark || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${reviewStateText(checkin.checkinTimecheck)}</td>
                        <td>${action}</td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
    }

    function loadManualHours() {

E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 299 页
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },

            }
        });
    }

    function openReview(checkinNum) {
        currentCheckinNum = checkinNum;
        $("#review_information").text("正在复核补录记录：" + checkinNum);
        $("#review_remark").val("");

    function submitReview(isPass) {
        if (currentCheckinNum === null) {
            alert("请先选择需要复核的补录记录");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/review/manualHours/check",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "checkinNum": currentCheckinNum,
                "isPass": isPass,
                "remark": $.trim($("#review_remark").val())
            },
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "复核已完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    if (reviewModal) {
                        reviewModal.hide();
                    }
                    currentCheckinNum = null;
                    loadManualHours();
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("复核提交失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

<script type="text/javascript">

    var page = 1;
    var size = 10;
    var keyword = "";

    function formatDate(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 10);
    }

    function renderPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {
        var total = totalCount || 0;
        page = currentPage || 1;

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function renderPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {
        var total = totalCount || 0;
        page = currentPage || 1;
        size = pageSize || size;
        var pages = total === 0 ? 1 : Math.ceil(total / size);
        $("#pager_info").text("共 " + total + " 条");
        $("#pager_page").text("第 " + page + " / " + pages + " 页");
        $("#btn_prev_page").prop("disabled", page <= 1);
        $("#btn_next_page").prop("disabled", page >= pages);
    }

    function renderShows(shows) {
        var $body = $("#show_table").empty();
        if (!shows || shows.length === 0) {
            $body.append('<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(shows, function (index, show) {
            html += `<tr>
                        <td>${show.volunteerName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${show.activityName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${show.showDetail || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${show.showBrowse || 0}</td>
                        <td>${show.showLike || 0}</td>
                        <td>${formatTime(show.showSharetime)}</td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-danger btn-sm" type="button"
                                    onclick="deleteShow(${show.showNum})">删除</button>
                        </td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
    }

<script type="text/javascript">

    var page = 1;
    var size = 10;
    var keyword = "";

    function renderPager(totalCount, currentPage, pageSize) {
        var total = totalCount || 0;
        page = currentPage || 1;
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 329 页
        size = pageSize || size;
        var pages = total === 0 ? 1 : Math.ceil(total / size);
        $("#pager_info").text("共 " + total + " 条");
        $("#pager_page").text("第 " + page + " / " + pages + " 页");
        $("#btn_prev_page").prop("disabled", page <= 1);
        $("#btn_next_page").prop("disabled", page >= pages);
    }

    function refreshExportLink() {
        var url = "/admin/account/export/volunteers";
        if (keyword) {
            url = url + "?keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(keyword);
        }
        $("#btn_export_volunteers").attr("href", url);
    }

    function renderVolunteers(volunteers) {
        var $body = $("#volunteer_table").empty();
        if (!volunteers || volunteers.length === 0) {
            $body.append('<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(volunteers, function (index, volunteer) {
            var enabled = volunteer.accountEnabled === 1;
            html += `<tr>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerId || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerName || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerTel || "—"}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerCredit || 0}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerTotalduration || 0}</td>
                        <td>${volunteer.volunteerNoshow || 0}</td>
                        <td>${enabled ? '<span class="badge badge-success">启用</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-secondary">停用</span>'}</td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                    onclick="toggleEnabled('${volunteer.volunteerId}', ${enabled ? 0 : 1})">${enabled ? "停用" : "启用"}</button>
                            <button class="btn btn-pill btn-outline-warning btn-sm" type="button"
                                    onclick="resetPassword('${volunteer.volunteerId}')">重置密码</button>
                        </td>
                     </tr>`;
        });
        $body.html(html);
    }

    function loadVolunteers() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/account/volunteers",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "page": page,
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 330 页
                "size": size,
                "keyword": keyword
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "志愿者名单加载失败");
                    return;
                }
                renderVolunteers(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("志愿者名单加载失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    function showOneTimePassword(title, msg, password) {
        $("#password_title").text(title);
        $("#password_msg").text(msg || "");
        $("#password_value").text(password);
        new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("passwordModal")).show();
    }

    function toggleEnabled(accountId, enabled) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/account/enabled",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "accountId": accountId,
                "enabled": enabled
            },
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作已完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    loadVolunteers();
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("账号状态修改失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    function resetPassword(accountId) {
        if (!confirm("确定重置账号 " + accountId + " 的登录密码吗？")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/admin/account/password/reset",
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 331 页
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "accountId": accountId
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result && result.code === 100 && result.extend && result.extend.password) {
                    showOneTimePassword("密码重置成功", result.msg, result.extend.password);
                    loadVolunteers();
                } else {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "密码重置失败");
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("密码重置失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    $("#btn_search_volunteer").click(function () {
        keyword = $.trim($("#volunteer_keyword").val());
        page = 1;
        refreshExportLink();
        loadVolunteers();
    });

    $("#btn_reset_volunteer").click(function () {
        $("#volunteer_keyword").val("");
        keyword = "";
        page = 1;
        refreshExportLink();
        loadVolunteers();
    });

    $("#volunteer_keyword").keydown(function (event) {
        if (event.keyCode === 13) {
            $("#btn_search_volunteer").click();
        }
    });

    $("#btn_prev_page").click(function () {
        if (page > 1) {
            page = page - 1;
            loadVolunteers();
        }
    });

    $("#btn_next_page").click(function () {
        page = page + 1;
        loadVolunteers();
    });

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 338 页

    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 339 页
    }

    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    var page = 1, size = 10, keyword = "";

    var activityModal = null;

    function renderActivityTable(list) {
        var tabValue = "";
        $.each(list, function (index, item) {
            tabValue += `<tr>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityName}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityBegintime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityEndtime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityLocation || "—"}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">
                                <div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="活动操作">
                                    <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                            onclick="activityInfo(${item.activityNum})">查看详情</button>
                                    <button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" type="button"
                                            onclick="auditActivityDelete(${item.activityNum})">删除</button>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                         </tr>`;
        });
        if (list.length === 0) {
            tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
        }
        $("#activity_table tbody").html(tabValue);
    }

    function load() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/findAuditActivityByNumAndState",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: page, size: size, keyword: keyword},
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 340 页
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                renderActivityTable(data.list);
                renderPager("activity_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    load();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function activityInfo(activityNum) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/activityInfo",
            type: "GET",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var actInfo = (result && result.extend && result.extend.activityInfo)
                    ? result.extend.activityInfo[0] : null;
                if (!actInfo) {
                    alert(tip(result, "活动详情加载失败"));
                    return;
                }
                $("#actvity_name").val(actInfo.activityName);
                $("#actvity_detail").val(actInfo.activityDetail);
                $("#actvity_begintime").val(formatTime(actInfo.activityBegintime));
                $("#actvity_endtime").val(formatTime(actInfo.activityEndtime));
                $("#actvity_signddl").val(formatTime(actInfo.activitySignddl));
                $("#actvity_location").val(actInfo.activityLocation);
                $("#actvity_needpeople").val(actInfo.activityNeedpeople);
                $("#actvity_notice").val(actInfo.activityNotice);
                if (!activityModal) {
                    activityModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("activityModal"));
                }
                activityModal.show();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function auditActivityDelete(activityNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定删除该活动吗？删除后不可恢复。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 341 页
            url: "/activity/auditActivityDelete",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "删除成功" : "删除失败"));
                if (success) {
                    load();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadUnreadCount();
        load();
        $("#search_button").click(function () {
            page = 1;
            keyword = $.trim($("#keyword").val());
            load();
        });
    });

    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    function tip(result, fallback) {

            return result;

    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({

                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);

    var page = 1, size = 10, keyword = "";

    function renderActivityTable(list) {

                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>

                            </td>
                         </tr>`;

            tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;

    function finishActivity(activityNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定结束该活动吗？结束后志愿者不能继续签到。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/finishActivity",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "活动已结束" : "活动结束失败"));
                if (success) {
                    load();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 362 页
    }

    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",

            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function renderActivityTable(list) {
        var tabValue = "";
        $.each(list, function (index, item) {
            tabValue += `<tr>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityName}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityBegintime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityEndtime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityLocation || "—"}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityChecktime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${reasonText(item)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">
                                <div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="活动操作">
                                    <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                            onclick="notAuditActivityChange(${item.activityNum})">修改</button>
                                    <button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" type="button"
                                            onclick="notAuditActivityDelete(${item.activityNum})">删除</button>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                         </tr>`;
        });
        if (list.length === 0) {
            tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
        }
        $("#activity_table tbody").html(tabValue);
    }

    function load() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/findNotAuditActivityByNumAndState",
            type: "GET",

            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                renderActivityTable(data.list);
                renderPager("activity_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    load();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);

            }

    function notAuditActivityChange(activityNum) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/activityInfo",
            type: "GET",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var actInfo = (result && result.extend && result.extend.activityInfo)
                    ? result.extend.activityInfo[0] : null;
                if (!actInfo) {
                    alert(tip(result, "活动详情加载失败"));
                    return;
                }
                currentNotAuditActivityNum = actInfo.activityNum;
                $("#activityInformation").html(buildReviseActForm());
                $("#actvity_name").val(actInfo.activityName);
                $("#actvity_detail").val(actInfo.activityDetail);
                $("#actvity_begintime").val(toDateTimeInput(actInfo.activityBegintime));
                $("#actvity_endtime").val(toDateTimeInput(actInfo.activityEndtime));
                $("#actvity_location").val(actInfo.activityLocation);
                $("#actvity_needpeople").val(actInfo.activityNeedpeople);
                $("#actvity_notice").val(actInfo.activityNotice);
                $("#actvity_signddl").val(toDateTimeInput(actInfo.activitySignddl));
                $("#actvity_latitude").val(actInfo.activityLatitude === null || actInfo.activityLatitude === undefined ? "" : actInfo.activityLatitude);
                $("#actvity_longitude").val(actInfo.activityLongitude === null || actInfo.activityLongitude === undefined ? "" : actInfo.activityLongitude);
                $("#actvity_radius").val(actInfo.activityRadius === null || actInfo.activityRadius === undefined ? 300 : actInfo.activityRadius);
                $("#actvity_revision").text(actInfo.activityRevision || 0);
                applyReviseSkillChecked(actInfo);
                if (!reviseModal) {
                    reviseModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("reviseModal"));
                }
                reviseModal.show();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function submitReviseAct() {
        if (currentNotAuditActivityNum === null) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/reviseAct",
            type: "POST",
            data: {

                "name": $("#actvity_name").val(),

                "radius": $("#actvity_radius").val()
            },
            success: function (result) {

                load();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function notAuditActivityDelete(activityNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定删除该活动吗？删除后不可恢复。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/notAuditActivityDelete",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "删除成功" : "删除失败"));
                if (success) {
                    load();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 374 页
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 375 页
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    var recruitActivityNum = null;
    var recruitPage = 1;
    var recruitSize = 10;
    var recruitKeyword = "";

    var recruitModal = null;

    var activityNames = {};

    function renderActivityTable(list) {
        var tabValue = "";
        $.each(list, function (index, item) {
            activityNames[item.activityNum] = item.activityName;
            tabValue += `<tr>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityName}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityBegintime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${formatTime(item.activityEndtime)}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityLocation || "—"}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">${item.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>
                            <td class="text-center">
                                <div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="活动操作">
                                    <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" type="button"
                                            onclick="openVolRecruit(${item.activityNum})">志愿者招募</button>
                                    <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                            onclick="startActivity(${item.activityNum})">开始活动</button>
                                    <a class="btn btn-outline-success btn-sm"
                                       href="/org/export/participants?activityNum=${item.activityNum}">导出报名名单</a>
                                    <a class="btn btn-outline-info btn-sm"
                                       href="/org/export/hours?activityNum=${item.activityNum}">导出服务时长</a>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                         </tr>`;
        });
        if (list.length === 0) {
            tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
        }
        $("#activity_table tbody").html(tabValue);
    }

    function load() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/findNotStartActivityByNumAndState",
            type: "GET",
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 376 页
            data: {page: page, size: size, keyword: keyword},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                renderActivityTable(data.list);
                renderPager("activity_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    load();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function startActivity(activityNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定开始该活动吗？开始后志愿者可凭签到码现场签到。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/startActivity",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "活动已开始" : "活动开始失败"));
                if (success) {
                    load();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function openVolRecruit(activityNum) {
        recruitActivityNum = activityNum;
        recruitPage = 1;
        recruitKeyword = "";
        $("#recruit_activity_name").text("：" + (activityNames[activityNum] || ""));
        loadRecruitList();
        if (!recruitModal) {
            recruitModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("volRecruitModal"));
        }
        recruitModal.show();
    }

    function applyStateText(state) {
        if (state === "0") {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 377 页
            return "待审核";
        }
        if (state === "1") {
            return '<span style="color: #009900">已通过</span>';
        }
        if (state === "2") {
            return '<span style="color: red">未通过</span>';
        }
        if (state === "3") {
            return "候补";
        }
        return "—";
    }

    function recruitControlHtml(item) {
        var buttons = "";
        if (item.participateApplystate === "0" || item.participateApplystate === "3") {
            buttons += `<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button"
                                onclick="volPassRecruit(${item.participateNum})">通过</button>
                        <button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" type="button"
                                onclick="volUnPassRecruit(${item.participateNum})">驳回</button>`;
        }
        if (item.participateApplystate === "0" || item.participateApplystate === "1"
            || item.participateApplystate === "3") {
            buttons += `<button class="btn btn-outline-warning btn-sm" type="button"
                                onclick="removeParticipate(${item.participateNum})">移除报名</button>`;
        }
        if (!buttons) {
            return "—";
        }
        return `<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="报名操作">${buttons}</div>`;
    }

    function loadRecruitList() {
        if (recruitActivityNum === null) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/volRecruit",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "activityNum": recruitActivityNum,
                "page": recruitPage,
                "size": recruitSize,
                "keyword": recruitKeyword
            },
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, recruitPage, recruitSize);
                var tabValue = "";
                $.each(data.list, function (index, item) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 378 页
                    var volunteer = item.volunteer || {};
                    var score = (item.matchScore === null || item.matchScore === undefined)
                        ? "—" : item.matchScore + " 分";
                    var reasons = item.matchReasons || "—";
                    var confirmText = item.participateConfirmstateText || "待确认";
                    var noshowText = (item.participateNoshow === 1)
                        ? '<span style="color: red">爽约</span>' : "正常";
                    tabValue += `<tr>
                                    <td class="text-center">${volunteer.volunteerId || "—"}</td>

                }
                $("#volRecruitList_table tbody").html(tabValue);
                renderPager("recruit_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    recruitPage = target;

            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });

    function removeParticipate(participateNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定移除该志愿者的报名记录吗？")) {
            return;

        $.ajax({
            url: "/participate/remove",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"participateNum": participateNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "报名已移除" : "移除报名失败"));
                if (success) {
                    loadRecruitList();
                    load();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 386 页
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    var page = 1, size = 10, activityNum = "";
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 387 页

    var announcements = {};

    var announcementModal = null;

    function loadActivityOptions(selector) {
        var urls = [
            "/activity/findNotStartActivityByNumAndState",
            "/activity/findCarryActivityByNumAndState",
            "/activity/findEndActivityByNumAndState"
        ];
        $.each(urls, function (index, url) {
            $.ajax({
                url: url,
                type: "GET",
                data: {"page": 1, "size": 100},
                success: function (result) {
                    var data = pageData(result, 1, 100);
                    var $select = $(selector);
                    $.each(data.list, function (i, activity) {
                        if ($select.find('option[value="' + activity.activityNum + '"]').length === 0) {
                            $select.append($("<option></option>").val(activity.activityNum)
                                .text(activity.activityName));
                        }
                    });
                },
                error: function (result) {
                    console.log(result);
                }
            });
        });
    }

    function loadAnnouncements() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/content/announcements",
            type: "GET",
            data: {"activityNum": activityNum, "page": page, "size": size},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                var tabValue = "";
                $.each(data.list, function (index, item) {
                    announcements[item.actannouncementNum] = item;
                    tabValue += `<tr>
                                    <td>${item.actannouncementName}</td>
                                    <td>${item.actannouncementDetail || "—"}</td>
                                    <td>${item.activityName || "—"}</td>
                                    <td>
                                        <div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="公告操作">
                                            <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" type="button"
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 388 页
                                                    onclick="openAnnouncementModal(${item.actannouncementNum})">编辑</button>
                                            <button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" type="button"
                                                    onclick="deleteAnnouncement(${item.actannouncementNum})">删除</button>
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                 </tr>`;
                });
                if (data.list.length === 0) {
                    tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
                }
                $("#announcement_table tbody").html(tabValue);
                renderPager("announcement_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    loadAnnouncements();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function openAnnouncementModal(announcementNum) {
        var announcement = announcementNum ? announcements[announcementNum] : null;
        $("#announcement_num").val(announcement ? announcement.actannouncementNum : "");
        $("#announcementModalLabel").text(announcement ? "编辑活动公告" : "新增活动公告");
        $("#announcement_name").val(announcement ? announcement.actannouncementName : "");
        $("#announcement_detail").val(announcement ? (announcement.actannouncementDetail || "") : "");
        if (announcement && $("#announcement_activity").find('option[value="' + announcement.activityNum + '"]').length === 0) {
            $("#announcement_activity").append($("<option></option>").val(announcement.activityNum)
                .text(announcement.activityName || ("活动 " + announcement.activityNum)));
        }
        $("#announcement_activity").val(announcement ? announcement.activityNum : ($("#activity_filter").val() || ""));
        if (!announcementModal) {
            announcementModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("announcementModal"));
        }
        announcementModal.show();
    }

    function saveAnnouncement() {
        var activityValue = $("#announcement_activity").val();
        var name = $.trim($("#announcement_name").val());
        var detail = $.trim($("#announcement_detail").val());
        if (!activityValue) {
            alert("请选择公告所属活动");
            return;
        }
        if (!name) {
            alert("请填写公告标题");
            return;
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 389 页
        }
        if (!detail) {
            alert("请填写公告内容");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/content/announcement/save",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "announcementNum": $("#announcement_num").val(),
                "activityNum": activityValue,
                "name": name,
                "detail": detail
            },
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "活动公告已保存" : "活动公告保存失败"));
                if (success) {
                    if (announcementModal) {
                        announcementModal.hide();
                    }
                    loadAnnouncements();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function deleteAnnouncement(announcementNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定删除该活动公告吗？删除后不可恢复。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/content/announcement/delete",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"announcementNum": announcementNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "活动公告已删除" : "活动公告删除失败"));
                if (success) {
                    loadAnnouncements();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 400 页
    }

    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    function loadUnreadCount() {

                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function copyConfirmCode() {
        var confirmCode = $.trim($("#confirm_code_value").text());
        if (!confirmCode || confirmCode === "—") {
            alert("当前没有可复制的服务确认码");
            return;
        }
        var $temp = $("<textarea></textarea>").val(confirmCode)
            .css({position: "fixed", top: "-1000px"}).appendTo("body");
        $temp[0].select();
        try {
            document.execCommand("copy");
            alert("服务确认码已复制");
        } catch (error) {
            alert("复制失败，请手动记录服务确认码：" + confirmCode);
        }
        $temp.remove();
    }

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 420 页
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }

    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 421 页
    }

    var page = 1, size = 5, keyword = "";

    function loadCount(url, holderId) {
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: 1, size: 1},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, 1, 1);
                $("#" + holderId).text(data.total);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function renderActivityTable(list) {
        var tabValue = "";
        $.each(list, function (index, activity) {
            tabValue += `<tr>
                            <td>${activity.activityName}</td>
                            <td>${activity.activityLocation || "—"}</td>
                            <td>${formatTime(activity.activityBegintime)}</td>
                            <td>${formatTime(activity.activityEndtime)}</td>
                            <td>${formatTime(activity.activitySignddl)}</td>
                            <td>${activity.activityNeedpeople || 0}</td>
                            <td><a class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" href="act_audit.html">查看</a></td>
                         </tr>`;
        });
        if (list.length === 0) {
            tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
        }
        $("#activity_table").html(tabValue);
    }

    function loadActivityList() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/findAuditActivityByNumAndState",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: page, size: size, keyword: keyword},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                renderActivityTable(data.list);
                $("#count_audit").text(data.total);
                renderPager("activity_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    loadActivityList();
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 422 页
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function loadOrganization() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/info",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || !result.extend || !result.extend.organization) {
                    return;
                }
                var org = result.extend.organization;
                $("#organization_name").text(org.organizationName);
                $("#organization_name_detail").text(org.organizationName);
                $("#organization_id").text(org.organizationId);
                $("#organization_date").text(formatTime(org.organizationEstablishdate).substring(0, 10));
                $("#organization_introduction").text(org.organizationIntroduction || "—");
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function loadNotifications() {

            url: "/org/notifications",
            type: "GET",
            data: {"page": page, "size": size},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, page, size);
                var tabValue = "";
                $.each(data.list, function (index, item) {
                    var unread = isUnread(item.notificationRead);
                    var stateHtml = unread
                        ? '<span class="badge bg-primary">未读</span>'
                        : '<span class="badge bg-secondary">已读</span>';
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 429 页
                    var titleHtml = unread
                        ? '<span class="f-w-600">' + item.notificationTitle + '</span>'
                        : (item.notificationTitle || "—");
                    var controlHtml = unread
                        ? '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button" onclick="markRead('
                            + item.notificationNum + ')">标记已读</button>'
                        : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';
                    tabValue += `<tr>
                                    <td>${stateHtml}</td>
                                    <td>${titleHtml}</td>
                                    <td>${item.notificationDetail || "—"}</td>
                                    <td>${formatTime(item.notificationTime)}</td>
                                    <td>${controlHtml}</td>
                                 </tr>`;
                });
                if (data.list.length === 0) {
                    tabValue = `<tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>`;
                }
                $("#notification_table tbody").html(tabValue);
                renderPager("notification_pager", data.total, data.page, data.size, function (target) {
                    page = target;
                    loadNotifications();
                });
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function markRead(notificationNum) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/read",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"notificationNum": notificationNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "通知已标记为已读" : "标记已读失败"));
                if (success) {
                    loadNotifications();
                    loadUnreadCount();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function readAll() {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 430 页
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/readAll",
            type: "POST",
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "已全部标记为已读" : "操作失败"));
                if (success) {
                    page = 1;
                    loadNotifications();
                    loadUnreadCount();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadUnreadCount();
        loadNotifications();
        $("#read_all_button").click(function () {
            readAll();
        });
    });

</script>

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toDateTimeInput(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 443 页
        return String(value).replace(" ", "T").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function toApiTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ");
    }

    function renderPager(holderId, total, page, size, onChange) {
        total = Number(total) || 0;
        page = Number(page) || 1;
        size = Number(size) || 10;
        var totalPage = Math.ceil(total / size);
        var currentPage = totalPage === 0 ? 0 : page;
        var html = '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center flex-wrap">'
            + '<span class="text-muted">共 ' + total + ' 条，第 ' + currentPage + ' / ' + totalPage + ' 页</span>'
            + '<div class="btn-group btn-group-pill" role="group" aria-label="分页">'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-prev" type="button"'
            + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>上一页</button>'
            + '<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm pager-next" type="button"'
            + (page >= totalPage ? ' disabled' : '') + '>下一页</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        var $holder = $("#" + holderId);
        $holder.html(html);
        $holder.find(".pager-prev").on("click", function () {
            if (page > 1) {
                onChange(page - 1);
            }
        });
        $holder.find(".pager-next").on("click", function () {
            if (page < totalPage) {
                onChange(page + 1);
            }
        });
    }

    function pageData(result, fallbackPage, fallbackSize) {
        var extend = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend : {};
        var total = Number(extend.total);
        var currentPage = Number(extend.page);
        var pageSize = Number(extend.size);
        return {
            list: extend.list || [],
            total: (isNaN(total) || total < 0) ? 0 : total,
            page: (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) ? fallbackPage : currentPage,
            size: (isNaN(pageSize) || pageSize < 1) ? fallbackSize : pageSize
        };
    }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 444 页

    function tip(result, fallback) {
        if (result && result.msg) {
            return result.msg;
        }
        if (typeof result === "string" && result) {
            return result;
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    function loadUnreadCount() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/notifications/unreadCount",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                var count = (result && result.extend) ? result.extend.count : 0;
                $("#unread_count").text((count === null || count === undefined) ? 0 : count);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function loadActivityOptions(selector) {

    function openTrainingModal(trainingNum) {
        var training = trainingNum ? trainings[trainingNum] : null;
        $("#training_num").val(training ? training.trainingNum : "");
        $("#trainingModalLabel").text(training ? "编辑培训安排" : "新增培训安排");
        $("#training_name").val(training ? training.trainingName : "");
        $("#training_detail").val(training ? (training.trainingDetail || "") : "");
        $("#training_begin").val(training ? toDateTimeInput(training.trainingBegintime) : "");
        $("#training_end").val(training ? toDateTimeInput(training.trainingEndtime) : "");
        $("#training_location").val(training ? (training.trainingLocation || "") : "");
        $("#training_checkin").val(training ? (training.trainingCheckin || "") : "");
        if (training && $("#training_activity").find('option[value="' + training.activityNum + '"]').length === 0) {
            $("#training_activity").append($("<option></option>").val(training.activityNum)
                .text(training.activityName || ("活动 " + training.activityNum)));
        }
        $("#training_activity").val(training ? training.activityNum : ($("#activity_filter").val() || ""));
        if (!trainingModal) {
            trainingModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("trainingModal"));
        }
        trainingModal.show();
    }

    function saveTraining() {
        var activityValue = $("#training_activity").val();
        var name = $.trim($("#training_name").val());
        var beginTime = toApiTime($("#training_begin").val());
        var endTime = toApiTime($("#training_end").val());
        if (!activityValue) {
            alert("请选择培训所属活动");
            return;
        }
        if (!name) {
            alert("请填写培训名称");
            return;
        }
        if (!beginTime || !endTime) {
            alert("请填写培训开始时间与结束时间");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/content/training/save",
            type: "POST",
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 447 页
            data: {
                "trainingNum": $("#training_num").val(),
                "activityNum": activityValue,
                "name": name,
                "detail": $("#training_detail").val(),
                "beginTime": beginTime,
                "endTime": endTime,
                "location": $("#training_location").val(),
                "checkin": $("#training_checkin").val()
            },
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "培训安排已保存" : "培训安排保存失败"));
                if (success) {
                    if (trainingModal) {
                        trainingModal.hide();
                    }
                    loadTrainings();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function deleteTraining(trainingNum) {
        if (!confirm("确定删除该培训安排吗？删除后不可恢复。")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/content/training/delete",
            type: "POST",
            data: {"trainingNum": trainingNum},
            success: function (result) {
                var success = result && result.code === 100;
                alert(tip(result, success ? "培训安排已删除" : "培训安排删除失败"));
                if (success) {
                    loadTrainings();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function openSituationModal(trainingNum) {

    function loadSituationVolunteers() {
        var training = trainings[currentTrainingNum] || {};
        if (!training.activityNum) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/activity/volRecruit",
            type: "GET",
            data: {"activityNum": training.activityNum, "page": 1, "size": 100},
            success: function (result) {
                var data = pageData(result, 1, 100);
                var $select = $("#situation_volunteer");
                var added = 0;
                $.each(data.list, function (index, item) {
                    if (item.participateApplystate !== "1") {
                        return true;
                    }
                    var volunteer = item.volunteer || {};
                    var label = (volunteer.volunteerName || "志愿者")
                        + "（" + (volunteer.volunteerId || item.volunteerNum) + "）";
                    $select.append($("<option></option>").val(item.volunteerNum).text(label));
                    added += 1;
                });
                if (added === 0) {
                    $("#situation_hint").text("该培训所属活动暂无已通过报名的志愿者").removeClass("d-none");
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function saveSituation() {

<script type="text/javascript">

    $("#activity_name").blur(function () {
        var name = $("#activity_name").val();
        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/checkname",
            type: "GET",
            data: {
                "name": name
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    $("#sp").val("");
                    $("#sp").html("   √   ").css("color", "green");
                } else {
                    $("#sp").val("");
                    $("#sp").html("   活动名称重复   ").css("color", "red");
                }
            }
        })
    });

    $("#upactivity_submit").click(function () {
        var name = $("#activity_name").val();
        var content = $("#activity_content").val();
        var startTime = $("#start_time").val();
        var endTime = $("#end_time").val();
        var location = $("#activity_location").val();
        var affair = $("#activity_affair").val();
        var need = $("#activity_need").val();
        var sign_ddl = $("#sign_ddl").val();
        var tags = collectSkillTags();
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 458 页
        var latitude = $("#activity_latitude").val();
        var longitude = $("#activity_longitude").val();
        var radius = $("#activity_radius").val();

        $.ajax({
            url: "/org/upact",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                "name": name,
                "content": content,
                "startTime": startTime,
                "endTime": endTime,
                "location": location,
                "affair": affair,
                "need": need,
                "sign_ddl": sign_ddl,
                "tags": tags,
                "latitude": latitude,
                "longitude": longitude,
                "radius": radius
            },
            success: function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    alert(result);
                    window.location.href = "act_audit.html";
                } else {
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        })
    })

    function collectSkillTags() {
        var tags = [];
        $(".skill_checkbox:checked").each(function () {
            tags.push($(this).val());
        });
        return tags.join(",");
    }

    $("#locate_activity").click(function () {
        if (!navigator.geolocation) {
            alert("当前浏览器不支持定位功能，请手动填写活动定位");
            return;
        }
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function (position) {
            $("#activity_latitude").val(position.coords.latitude.toFixed(6));
            $("#activity_longitude").val(position.coords.longitude.toFixed(6));
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 459 页
        }, function () {
            alert("定位失败，请检查浏览器定位权限后重试");
        });
    });
</script>
