    function portalEscapeHtml(value) {
        if (value === null || value === undefined) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function portalSummary(value, length) {
        var text = value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value);
        return text.length > length ? text.substring(0, length) + "…" : text;
    }

    function portalFormatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function portalListOf(result) {
        return result && result.extend && result.extend.list ? result.extend.list : [];
    }

    function portalEmptyTip(container, message) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="col-12"><p class="text-muted">'
            + portalEscapeHtml(message) + '</p></div>';
    }

    var PORTAL_ACTIVITY_STATE = {"1": "未开始", "2": "进行中"};

    function portalLoadAnnouncements() {
        var container = document.getElementById("announcementList");
        fetch("/portal/site/announcements?page=1&size=5").then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 464 页
        }).then(function (result) {
            var list = portalListOf(result);
            if (!list.length) {
                portalEmptyTip(container, "暂无数据");
                return;
            }
            var html = "";
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                var announcement = list[i];
                html += '<div class="col-12"><div class="card"><div class="card-body">'
                    + '<h4 class="card-title"><a href="javascript:void(0)" class="portal-announcement-link" data-num="'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(announcement.policyannouncementNum) + '">'
                    + portalEscapeHtml(announcement.policyannouncementName) + '</a></h4>'
                    + '<p>' + portalEscapeHtml(portalSummary(announcement.policyannouncementDetail, 80)) + '</p>'
                    + '<p class="text-muted">附件 ' + Number(announcement.fileCount || 0) + ' 个</p>'
                    + '</div></div></div>';
            }
            container.innerHTML = html;
            var links = container.querySelectorAll(".portal-announcement-link");
            for (var j = 0; j < links.length; j++) {
                links[j].addEventListener("click", function () {
                    portalShowAnnouncement(this.getAttribute("data-num"));
                });
            }
        }).catch(function () {
            portalEmptyTip(container, "暂无数据");
        });
    }

    function portalShowAnnouncement(policyannouncementNum) {
        fetch("/portal/site/announcement?policyannouncementNum=" + encodeURIComponent(policyannouncementNum))
            .then(function (response) {
                return response.json();
            }).then(function (result) {
                var announcement = result.extend ? result.extend.announcement : null;
                if (result.code !== 100 || !announcement) {
                    alert(result.msg || "该通知公告不存在或已被删除");
                    return;
                }
                var files = announcement.files ? announcement.files : [];
                var fileHtml = "";
                if (files.length) {
                    fileHtml = '<ul class="list">';
                    for (var i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
                        fileHtml += '<li><a href="' + portalEscapeHtml(files[i].policyfileRoute) + '">'
                            + portalEscapeHtml(files[i].policyfileName) + '</a></li>';
                    }
                    fileHtml += '</ul>';
                } else {
                    fileHtml = '<p class="text-muted">该公告没有附件</p>';
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 465 页
                }
                portalOpenModal(announcement.policyannouncementName,
                    '<p>' + portalEscapeHtml(announcement.policyannouncementDetail).replace(/\n/g, "<br>") + '</p>'
                    + '<h4>附件下载</h4>' + fileHtml);
            }).catch(function () {
                alert("通知公告详情加载失败，请稍后重试");
            });
    }

    function showConfirmResult(msg, isConfirmed) {
        var box = document.getElementById("confirmResult");
        box.innerHTML = `<div class="alert ${isConfirmed ? "alert-success" : "alert-warning"}" role="alert">
                            <h4 class="card-title" id="confirmResultTitle"></h4>
                            <p class="mb-0" id="confirmResultMsg"></p>
                        </div>`;
        document.getElementById("confirmResultTitle").textContent = isConfirmed ? "服务确认成功" : "服务否认已记录";
        document.getElementById("confirmResultMsg").textContent = msg;
    }

    function showConfirmError(msg) {
        var box = document.getElementById("confirmResult");
        box.innerHTML = `<div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">
                            <h4 class="card-title">服务确认未完成</h4>
                            <p class="mb-0" id="confirmResultError"></p>
                        </div>`;
        document.getElementById("confirmResultError").textContent = msg;
    }

    document.getElementById("confirmForm").addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var resultInput = document.querySelector('input[name="resultValue"]:checked');
        var resultValue = resultInput ? resultInput.value : "";
        var data = new URLSearchParams();
        data.append("confirmCode", document.getElementById("confirmCode").value.trim());
        data.append("objectPhone", document.getElementById("objectPhone").value.trim());
        data.append("resultValue", resultValue);
        data.append("objectRemark", document.getElementById("objectRemark").value.trim());

        var button = document.getElementById("btn_confirm");
        button.disabled = true;
        document.getElementById("confirmResult").innerHTML = "";

        fetch("/portal/site/service-confirm", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8"},
            body: data
        }).then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            if (result.code === 100) {
                showConfirmResult(result.msg, resultValue === "1");
            } else {
                showConfirmError(result.msg);
            }
        }).catch(function () {
            showConfirmError("服务确认暂时不可用，请稍后重试");
        }).then(function () {
            button.disabled = false;
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 471 页
        });
    });

<script type="text/javascript">

    var showPage = 1;
    var showSize = 6;
    var showKeyword = "";

    function portalEscapeHtml(value) {
        if (value === null || value === undefined) {
            return "";
        }
        return String(value).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
            .replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function portalSummary(value, length) {
        var text = value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value);
        return text.length > length ? text.substring(0, length) + "…" : text;
    }

    function portalFormatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function portalListOf(result) {
        return result && result.extend && result.extend.list ? result.extend.list : [];
    }

    function portalRenderPager(total, page, size) {
        var totalPage = total > 0 ? Math.ceil(total / size) : 0;
        document.getElementById("showPageInfo").textContent =
            "第 " + (totalPage > 0 ? page : 0) + " / " + totalPage + " 页，共 " + total + " 条";
        document.getElementById("showPrevPage").disabled = page <= 1;
        document.getElementById("showNextPage").disabled = totalPage === 0 || page >= totalPage;
    }

    function portalEmptyList() {
        document.getElementById("showList").innerHTML =
            '<div class="col-12"><p class="text-muted">暂无数据</p></div>';
    }

    function portalLoadShows() {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 475 页
        var container = document.getElementById("showList");
        var url = "/portal/site/shows?page=" + showPage + "&size=" + showSize
            + "&keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(showKeyword);
        fetch(url).then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            var list = portalListOf(result);
            var extend = result.extend ? result.extend : {};
            portalRenderPager(Number(extend.total || 0), Number(extend.page || showPage),
                Number(extend.size || showSize));
            if (!list.length) {
                portalEmptyList();

            }
            var html = "";

                if (show.pictureRoute) {
                    html += '<img class="card-img-top" src="' + portalEscapeHtml(show.pictureRoute)
                        + '" alt="' + portalEscapeHtml(show.activityName || "志愿秀图片")

            for (var j = 0; j < buttons.length; j++) {

            portalRenderPager(0, 1, showSize);
            portalEmptyList();
        });

    function portalShowDetail(showNum) {
        fetch("/portal/site/show?showNum=" + encodeURIComponent(showNum)).then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            var show = result.extend ? result.extend.show : null;
            if (result.code !== 100 || !show) {
                alert(result.msg || "该志愿秀不存在或已被删除");
                return;
            }
            var pictures = show.pictureRoutes ? show.pictureRoutes : [];
            var pictureHtml = "";
            if (pictures.length) {
                for (var i = 0; i < pictures.length; i++) {
                    pictureHtml += '<p><img src="' + portalEscapeHtml(pictures[i])
                        + '" alt="志愿秀图片" style="max-width:100%;"/></p>';
                }
            } else {
                pictureHtml = '<p class="text-muted">该志愿秀没有上传图片</p>';
            }
            portalOpenModal(show.volunteerName || "志愿秀详情",
                '<p class="text-muted">关联活动：' + portalEscapeHtml(show.activityName || "未关联活动")
                + ' · 分享时间：' + portalEscapeHtml(portalFormatTime(show.showSharetime))
                + ' · 浏览 ' + Number(show.showBrowse || 0) + ' 次 · 点赞 '
                + Number(show.showLike || 0) + ' 次</p>'
                + '<p>' + portalEscapeHtml(show.showDetail).replace(/\n/g, "<br>") + '</p>'
                + '<h4>志愿秀图片</h4>' + pictureHtml);

            portalLoadShows();
        }).catch(function () {
            alert("志愿秀详情加载失败，请稍后重试");
        });
    }

    function portalOpenModal(title, bodyHtml) {
        document.getElementById("portalModalTitle").textContent = title || "";
        document.getElementById("portalModalBody").innerHTML = bodyHtml;
        document.getElementById("portalModal").style.display = "block";
    }

    function portalCloseModal() {
        document.getElementById("portalModal").style.display = "none";
    }

    document.getElementById("portalModalClose").addEventListener("click", portalCloseModal);
    document.getElementById("portalModal").addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (event.target === this) {
            portalCloseModal();
        }
    });

    document.getElementById("showSearchForm").addEventListener("submit", function (event) {

        portalLoadShows();

    document.getElementById("showPrevPage").addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (showPage > 1) {
            showPage = showPage - 1;
            portalLoadShows();
        }
    });

    document.getElementById("showNextPage").addEventListener("click", function () {
        showPage = showPage + 1;

<script type="text/javascript">

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function formatDuration(value) {
        if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") {
            return "—";
        }
        return Number(value).toFixed(1) + " 小时";
    }

    function showVerifyError(msg) {
        var box = document.getElementById("verifyResult");
        box.innerHTML = "";
        var tip = document.createElement("p");
        tip.className = "text-danger";
        tip.textContent = msg;
        box.appendChild(tip);
    }

    function showVerifyCard(verification) {
        var box = document.getElementById("verifyResult");
        box.innerHTML = `<div class="card">
                            <div class="card-body">
                                <h4 class="card-title">志愿服务证明校验结果</h4>
                                <ul class="list">
                                    <li>志愿者编号：<span id="verifyVolunteerId"></span></li>
                                    <li>姓名：<span id="verifyVolunteerName"></span></li>
                                    <li>累计服务时长：<span id="verifyTotalDuration"></span></li>
                                    <li>参与志愿活动数：<span id="verifyActivityCount"></span></li>
                                    <li>星级：<span id="verifyStarLevel"></span></li>
                                    <li>签发日期：<span id="verifyIssueDate"></span></li>
                                </ul>
                                <p class="text-success" id="verifyConclusion">校验通过，该证明真实有效</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
        document.getElementById("verifyVolunteerId").textContent = verification.volunteerId || "—";
        document.getElementById("verifyVolunteerName").textContent = verification.volunteerName || "—";
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 481 页
        document.getElementById("verifyTotalDuration").textContent = formatDuration(verification.totalDuration);
        document.getElementById("verifyActivityCount").textContent =
            (verification.activityCount === null || verification.activityCount === undefined) ? "—" : verification.activityCount;
        document.getElementById("verifyStarLevel").textContent = verification.starLevel || "—";
        document.getElementById("verifyIssueDate").textContent = formatTime(verification.issueDate);
    }

    document.getElementById("verifyForm").addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var data = new URLSearchParams();
        data.append("volunteerId", document.getElementById("volunteerId").value.trim());
        data.append("code", document.getElementById("code").value.trim());
        document.getElementById("verifyResult").innerHTML = "";
        fetch("/certificate/verify", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8"},
            body: data
        }).then(function (response) {
            return response.json();
        }).then(function (result) {
            var verification = result.extend ? result.extend.verification : null;
            if (result.code === 100 && verification && verification.valid === true) {
                showVerifyCard(verification);
            } else {
                showVerifyError(result.msg);
            }
        }).catch(function () {
            showVerifyError("校验服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试");
        });
    });

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 486 页
    }

    function formatActivityTime(activity) {
        var begin = formatTime(activity.activityBegintime);
        var end = formatTime(activity.activityEndtime);
        if (begin === "—" && end === "—") {
            return "—";
        }
        return begin + " ~ " + end;
    }

    function formatScore(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num) || num < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        return Math.round(num);
    }

    function renderScore(value) {
        var score = formatScore(value);
        return '<div class="progress" style="height: 6px; width: 70px; display: inline-block;'
            + ' vertical-align: middle;">'
            + '<div class="progress-bar" role="progressbar" style="width: ' + score + '%;" aria-valuenow="'
            + score + '" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100"></div>'
            + '</div> <span class="small">' + score + ' 分</span>';
    }

    function formatDistance(distanceMeters) {
        if (distanceMeters === null || distanceMeters === undefined) {
            return "未设置定位";
        }
        var meters = Number(distanceMeters);
        if (isNaN(meters) || meters < 0) {
            return "未设置定位";
        }
        if (meters < 1000) {
            return Math.round(meters) + " 米";
        }
        return (meters / 1000).toFixed(1) + " 公里";
    }

    function formatSkillNames(skillNames) {
        if (!skillNames) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(skillNames).replace(/,/g, "、");
    }

    function formatReasons(reasons) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 487 页
        if (!reasons || reasons.length === 0) {
            return "—";
        }
        return reasons.join("；");
    }

    var volunteerProfile = null;
    var profileRequest = null;

    function loadProfile(onLoaded) {
        profileRequest = $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/profile",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.profile) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                volunteerProfile = result.extend.profile;
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(volunteerProfile.volunteerName || "志愿者");
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (volunteerProfile.volunteerId || "—"));
                if (onLoaded) {
                    onLoaded(volunteerProfile);
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
        return profileRequest;
    }

    function ensureProfile(callback) {
        if (volunteerProfile) {
            callback(volunteerProfile);
            return;
        }
        if (!profileRequest) {
            loadProfile(callback);
            return;
        }
        profileRequest.always(function () {
            callback(volunteerProfile);
        });
    }

    function renderPlaza(activities) {
        var html = "";
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 488 页
        if (!activities || activities.length === 0) {
            html = '<tr><td colspan="9" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>';
        } else {
            $.each(activities, function (index, activity) {
                html += "<tr>"
                    + "<td>" + activity.activityName + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatActivityTime(activity) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (activity.activityLocation || "—") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + ((activity.activityNeedpeople === null || activity.activityNeedpeople === undefined)
                        ? "—" : activity.activityNeedpeople + " 人") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatDistance(activity.distanceMeters) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatSkillNames(activity.activitySkillNames) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + renderScore(activity.matchScore) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatReasons(activity.reasons) + "</td>"
                    + '<td><button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button" onclick="applyActivity('
                    + activity.activityNum + ')">报名</button></td>'
                    + "</tr>";
            });
        }
        $("#plaza_table").html(html);
    }

    var plazaPage = 1;
    var plazaSize = 10;
    var plazaKeyword = "";
    var plazaTotal = 0;

    function renderPager(total, current, pageSize) {
        plazaTotal = Number(total);
        if (isNaN(plazaTotal) || plazaTotal < 0) {
            plazaTotal = 0;
        }
        var currentPage = Number(current);
        if (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) {
            currentPage = 1;
        }
        var currentSize = Number(pageSize);
        if (isNaN(currentSize) || currentSize < 1) {
            currentSize = plazaSize;
        }
        var totalPages = plazaTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(plazaTotal / currentSize) : 1;
        $("#plaza_total").text("共 " + plazaTotal + " 条");
        $("#plaza_page_info").text("第 " + currentPage + " / " + totalPages + " 页");
        $("#plaza_prev").toggleClass("disabled", currentPage <= 1);
        $("#plaza_next").toggleClass("disabled",
            plazaTotal === 0 || currentPage >= totalPages);
    }

    function loadPlaza() {
        $.ajax({
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 489 页
            url: "/volunteer/plaza",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: plazaPage, size: plazaSize, keyword: plazaKeyword},
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                renderPlaza(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function searchPlaza() {
        plazaKeyword = $.trim($("#plaza_keyword").val());
        plazaPage = 1;
        loadPlaza();
    }

    function changePlazaPage(step) {
        var nextPage = plazaPage + step;
        var totalPages = plazaTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(plazaTotal / plazaSize) : 1;
        if (nextPage < 1 || nextPage > totalPages) {
            return;
        }
        plazaPage = nextPage;
        loadPlaza();
    }

    function applyActivity(activityNum) {
        ensureProfile(function (profile) {
            var skills = (profile && profile.skills) ? profile.skills : [];
            var hasLocation = !!(profile && profile.latitude !== null && profile.latitude !== undefined
                && profile.longitude !== null && profile.longitude !== undefined);
            if (!profile || skills.length === 0 || !hasLocation) {
                if (confirm("请先在“我的档案”中完善技能标签与常住定位，是否现在前往完善？")) {
                    window.location.href = "profile.html";
                }
                return;
            }
            $.ajax({
                url: "/volunteer/apply",
                type: "POST",
                data: {activityNum: activityNum},
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 490 页
                success: function (result) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                    if (result && result.code === 100) {
                        loadPlaza();
                    }
                },
                error: function (result) {
                    console.log(result);
                    alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
                }
            });
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        $("#plaza_keyword").on("keydown", function (event) {
            if (event.keyCode === 13) {
                searchPlaza();
                return false;
            }
        });
        loadProfile();
        loadPlaza();
    });

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function formatHours(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num)) {
            num = 0;
        }
        return num.toFixed(1);
    }

    function formatActivityTime(activity) {
        var begin = formatTime(activity.activityBegintime);
        var end = formatTime(activity.activityEndtime);
        if (begin === "—" && end === "—") {
            return "—";
        }
        return begin + " ~ " + end;
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 503 页
    }

    var volunteerProfile = null;

    function loadProfile(onLoaded) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/profile",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.profile) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                volunteerProfile = result.extend.profile;
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(volunteerProfile.volunteerName || "志愿者");
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (volunteerProfile.volunteerId || "—"));
                if (onLoaded) {
                    onLoaded(volunteerProfile);
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function renderProfile(profile) {
        $("#stat_duration").text(formatHours(profile.volunteerTotalDuration));
        $("#stat_credit").text((profile.volunteerCredit === null || profile.volunteerCredit === undefined)
            ? "—" : profile.volunteerCredit);
        $("#stat_star").text(profile.starLevel || "—");

        var nextLevelName = profile.nextLevelName;
        var nextLevelHours = Number(profile.nextLevelHours);
        var hoursToNextLevel = Number(profile.hoursToNextLevel);
        if (!nextLevelName || isNaN(nextLevelHours) || nextLevelHours <= 0) {
            $("#growth_text").text("已达成最高星级，感谢您的持续付出");
            $("#growth_progress").css("width", "100%").attr("aria-valuenow", 100);
            return;
        }
        if (isNaN(hoursToNextLevel) || hoursToNextLevel < 0) {
            hoursToNextLevel = 0;
        }
        var achieved = nextLevelHours - hoursToNextLevel;
        if (achieved < 0) {
            achieved = 0;
        }
        var percent = Math.round(achieved / nextLevelHours * 100);

        if (percent > 100) {

        $("#growth_progress").css("width", percent + "%").attr("aria-valuenow", percent);

    function renderRecommend(activities) {
        var $holder = $("#recommend_list").empty();
        if (!activities || activities.length === 0) {
            $holder.append('<div class="col-12 text-center text-muted">暂无数据</div>');
            return;
        }
        var html = "";
        $.each(activities.slice(0, 3), function (index, activity) {
            html += '<div class="col-md-4">'
                + '<div class="card o-hidden">'
                + '<div class="card-body">'
                + '<h6 class="mb-1">' + activity.activityName + '</h6>'
                + '<p class="mb-1 text-muted small">服务时间：' + formatActivityTime(activity) + '</p>'
                + '<p class="mb-1 text-muted small">活动地点：' + (activity.activityLocation || "—") + '</p>'
                + '<p class="mb-2">匹配度：<span class="badge badge-primary">' + formatScore(activity.matchScore) + ' 分</span></p>'
                + renderReasons(activity.reasons)
                + '<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button" onclick="applyActivity('
                + activity.activityNum + ')">报名</button>'
                + '</div>'
                + '</div>'
                + '</div>';
        });
        $holder.html(html);
    }

    function formatScore(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num) || num < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        return Math.round(num);
    }

    function renderReasons(reasons) {
        if (!reasons || reasons.length === 0) {
            return '<p class="mb-2 text-muted small">暂无匹配理由</p>';
        }
        var html = '<ul class="list-unstyled mb-2 small">';
        $.each(reasons, function (index, reason) {

        });
        html += '</ul>';
        return html;

    function renderParticipations(participations) {
        var html = "";
        if (!participations || participations.length === 0) {
            html = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>';
        } else {
            $.each(participations, function (index, item) {
                html += "<tr>"

                    + "<td>" + formatTime(item.participateApplytime) + "</td>"
                    + '<td><span class="' + applyStateClass(item.participateApplystate) + '">'
                    + (item.participateApplystateText || "—") + '</span></td>'
                    + "<td>" + ((item.participateDuration === null || item.participateDuration === undefined)
                        ? "—" : formatHours(item.participateDuration) + " 小时") + "</td>"
                    + "</tr>";
            });
        }
        $("#participation_table").html(html);
    }

    function applyStateClass(state) {
        if (state === "1") {
            return "text-success";
        }
        if (state === "2") {
            return "text-danger";
        }
        if (state === "3") {
            return "text-warning";
        }
        return "text-muted";
    }

<script type="text/javascript">

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function formatHours(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num)) {
            num = 0;
        }
        return num.toFixed(1);
    }

    function formatActivityTime(item) {
        var begin = formatTime(item.activityBegintime);
        var end = formatTime(item.activityEndtime);
        if (begin === "—" && end === "—") {
            return "—";
        }
        return begin + " ~ " + end;
    }

    function loadProfile() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/profile",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.profile) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                var profile = result.extend.profile;
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(profile.volunteerName || "志愿者");
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (profile.volunteerId || "—"));
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 513 页
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function applyStateHtml(item) {
        var stateClass = "text-muted";
        if (item.participateApplystate === "1") {
            stateClass = "text-success";
        } else if (item.participateApplystate === "2") {
            stateClass = "text-danger";
        } else if (item.participateApplystate === "3") {
            stateClass = "text-warning";
        }
        return '<span class="' + stateClass + '">' + (item.participateApplystateText || "—") + '</span>';
    }

    function timecheckHtml(value) {
        if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== "" && String(value) === "1") {
            return '<span class="badge badge-success">已确认</span>';
        }
        if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== "" && String(value) === "2") {
            return '<span class="badge badge-danger">已驳回</span>';
        }
        return '<span class="badge badge-secondary">待复核</span>';
    }

    function sourceHtml(item) {
        if (item.checkinSource === null || item.checkinSource === undefined || item.checkinSource === "") {
            return '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';
        }
        var source = String(item.checkinSource);
        if (source === "1") {
            return '<span class="badge badge-primary">平台签到</span>';
        }
        if (source === "2") {
            return '<span class="badge badge-warning">组织补录</span>';
        }
        return '<span class="badge badge-secondary">' + source + '</span>';
    }

    function confirmStateHtml(item) {
        var text = item.participateConfirmstateText || "待确认";
        if (item.participateConfirmstate === "1") {
            return '<span class="text-success">' + text + '</span>';
        }
        if (item.participateConfirmstate === "2") {
            return '<span class="text-danger">' + text + '</span>';
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 514 页
        }
        return '<span class="text-warning">' + text + '</span>';
    }

    var partPage = 1;
    var partSize = 10;
    var partTotal = 0;

    function renderPager(total, current, pageSize) {
        partTotal = Number(total);
        if (isNaN(partTotal) || partTotal < 0) {
            partTotal = 0;
        }
        var currentPage = Number(current);
        if (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) {
            currentPage = 1;
        }
        var currentSize = Number(pageSize);
        if (isNaN(currentSize) || currentSize < 1) {
            currentSize = partSize;
        }
        var totalPages = partTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(partTotal / currentSize) : 1;
        $("#part_total").text("共 " + partTotal + " 条");
        $("#part_page_info").text("第 " + currentPage + " / " + totalPages + " 页");
        $("#part_prev").toggleClass("disabled", currentPage <= 1);
        $("#part_next").toggleClass("disabled", partTotal === 0 || currentPage >= totalPages);
    }

    function changePartPage(step) {
        var nextPage = partPage + step;
        var totalPages = partTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(partTotal / partSize) : 1;
        if (nextPage < 1 || nextPage > totalPages) {
            return;
        }
        partPage = nextPage;
        loadParticipations();
    }

    function actionHtml(item) {
        var buttons = "";
        if (item.canConfirm) {
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-success btn-xs" type="button" onclick="confirmParticipation('
                + item.participateNum + ', 1)">确认参加</button> ';
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-outline-warning btn-xs" type="button" onclick="confirmParticipation('
                + item.participateNum + ', 2)">放弃参加</button> ';
        }
        if (item.canCheckin) {
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button" onclick="prepareCheckin('
                + item.activityNum + ')" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#checkinModal">签到</button> ';
        }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 515 页
        if (item.canCheckout) {
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-info btn-xs" type="button" onclick="checkoutActivity('
                + item.activityNum + ')">签退</button> ';
        }
        if (item.canCancel) {
            buttons += '<button class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-xs" type="button" onclick="cancelParticipation('
                + item.participateNum + ')">撤回报名</button> ';
        }
        buttons += '<a class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-xs" href="training.html">查看公告</a>';
        return buttons;
    }

    function renderParticipations(participations) {
        var html = "";
        if (!participations || participations.length === 0) {
            html = '<tr><td colspan="10" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>';
        } else {
            $.each(participations, function (index, item) {
                html += "<tr>"
                    + "<td>" + item.activityName + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatActivityTime(item) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (item.activityLocation || "—") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatTime(item.participateApplytime) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + applyStateHtml(item) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + confirmStateHtml(item) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + ((item.participateDuration === null || item.participateDuration === undefined)
                        ? "—" : formatHours(item.participateDuration) + " 小时") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + timecheckHtml(item.participateTimecheck) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + sourceHtml(item) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + actionHtml(item) + "</td>"
                    + "</tr>";
            });
        }
        $("#participation_table").html(html);
    }

    function loadParticipations() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/myParticipations",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: partPage, size: partSize},
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                renderParticipations(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 516 页
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function getPosition(callback) {
        if (!navigator.geolocation) {
            callback("", "");
            return;
        }
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function (position) {
            callback(position.coords.latitude, position.coords.longitude);
        }, function () {
            callback("", "");
        }, {enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000, maximumAge: 0});
    }

    function prepareCheckin(activityNum) {
        $("#checkin_activity_num").val(activityNum);
        $("#checkin_code").val("");
        $("#checkin_latitude").val("");
        $("#checkin_longitude").val("");
    }

    function fillCheckinLocation() {
        getPosition(function (latitude, longitude) {
            if (latitude === "" || longitude === "") {
                alert("未能获取当前位置，可直接提交签到，系统将标记为异常并交志愿者组织复核");
                return;
            }
            $("#checkin_latitude").val(latitude);
            $("#checkin_longitude").val(longitude);
        });
    }

    function hideCheckinModal() {
        var modalElement = document.getElementById("checkinModal");
        if (window.bootstrap && bootstrap.Modal && modalElement) {
            var modalInstance = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(modalElement);
            if (modalInstance) {
                modalInstance.hide();
            }
        }
    }

    function submitCheckin() {
        var code = $.trim($("#checkin_code").val());
        if (!code) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 517 页
            alert("请输入现场公布的签到码");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/checkin/in",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                activityNum: $("#checkin_activity_num").val(),
                code: code,
                latitude: $("#checkin_latitude").val(),
                longitude: $("#checkin_longitude").val()
            },
            success: function (result) {
                hideCheckinModal();
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                loadParticipations();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                hideCheckinModal();
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
                loadParticipations();
            }
        });
    }

    function checkoutActivity(activityNum) {
        getPosition(function (latitude, longitude) {
            $.ajax({
                url: "/checkin/out",
                type: "POST",
                data: {activityNum: activityNum, latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude},
                success: function (result) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                    loadParticipations();
                },
                error: function (result) {
                    console.log(result);
                    alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
                    loadParticipations();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    function cancelParticipation(participateNum) {
        if (!confirm("确认撤回该志愿活动的报名？")) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 518 页
            url: "/volunteer/cancel",
            type: "POST",
            data: {participateNum: participateNum},
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                loadParticipations();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
                loadParticipations();
            }
        });
    }

    function confirmParticipation(participateNum, confirmState) {
        var tip = confirmState === 1
            ? "确认参加该志愿活动？"
            : "放弃参加后名额将释放给候补志愿者，确认放弃？";
        if (!confirm(tip)) {
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/confirm",
            type: "POST",
            data: {participateNum: participateNum, confirmState: confirmState},
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                loadParticipations();
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
                loadParticipations();
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadProfile();
        loadParticipations();
    });

<script type="text/javascript">

    function formatTime(value) {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 523 页
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    var notifPage = 1;
    var notifSize = 10;
    var notifTotal = 0;

    function isUnread(item) {
        return String(item.notificationRead) !== "1";
    }

    function loadProfile() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/profile",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.profile) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                var profile = result.extend.profile;
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(profile.volunteerName || "志愿者");
                $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (profile.volunteerId || "—"));
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function renderNotifications(notifications) {
        var html = "";
        if (!notifications || notifications.length === 0) {
            html = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center text-muted">暂无数据</td></tr>';
        } else {
            $.each(notifications, function (index, item) {
                var unread = isUnread(item);
                html += "<tr" + (unread ? ' class="table-primary"' : "") + ">"
                    + "<td>" + (item.notificationTitle || "—") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (item.notificationDetail || "—") + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + formatTime(item.notificationTime) + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (unread
                        ? '<span class="badge badge-danger">未读</span>'
                        : '<span class="badge badge-secondary">已读</span>') + "</td>"
                    + "<td>" + (unread
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 524 页
                        ? '<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button" onclick="markRead('
                            + item.notificationNum + ')">标记已读</button>'
                        : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>') + "</td>"
                    + "</tr>";
            });
        }
        $("#notification_table").html(html);
    }

    function renderPager(total, current, pageSize) {
        notifTotal = Number(total);
        if (isNaN(notifTotal) || notifTotal < 0) {
            notifTotal = 0;
        }
        var currentPage = Number(current);
        if (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) {
            currentPage = 1;
        }
        var currentSize = Number(pageSize);
        if (isNaN(currentSize) || currentSize < 1) {
            currentSize = notifSize;
        }
        var totalPages = notifTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(notifTotal / currentSize) : 1;
        $("#notif_total").text("共 " + notifTotal + " 条");
        $("#notif_page_info").text("第 " + currentPage + " / " + totalPages + " 页");
        $("#notif_prev").toggleClass("disabled", currentPage <= 1);
        $("#notif_next").toggleClass("disabled", notifTotal === 0 || currentPage >= totalPages);
    }

    function loadNotifications() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/notifications",
            type: "GET",
            data: {page: notifPage, size: notifSize},
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                renderNotifications(result.extend.list);
                renderPager(result.extend.total, result.extend.page, result.extend.size);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 525 页
    function changeNotifPage(step) {
        var nextPage = notifPage + step;
        var totalPages = notifTotal > 0 ? Math.ceil(notifTotal / notifSize) : 1;
        if (nextPage < 1 || nextPage > totalPages) {
            return;
        }
        notifPage = nextPage;
        loadNotifications();
    }

    function markRead(notificationNum) {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/notifications/read",
            type: "POST",
            data: {notificationNum: notificationNum},
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    loadNotifications();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    function markAllRead() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/notifications/readAll",
            type: "POST",
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    notifPage = 1;
                    loadNotifications();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadProfile();
        loadNotifications();
    });
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 526 页
</script>

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function formatHours(value) {
        var num = Number(value);
        if (isNaN(num)) {
            num = 0;
        }
        return num.toFixed(1);
    }

    function hasLocation(latitude, longitude) {
        return latitude !== null && latitude !== undefined && latitude !== ""
            && longitude !== null && longitude !== undefined && longitude !== "";
    }

    function renderProfile(profile) {
        $("#sidebar_volunteer_name").text(profile.volunteerName || "志愿者");
        $("#sidebar_volunteer_id").text("编号：" + (profile.volunteerId || "—"));

        $("#profile_name").text(profile.volunteerName || "—");
        $("#profile_id").text(profile.volunteerId || "—");
        $("#profile_tel").text(profile.volunteerTel || "—");
        $("#profile_gender").text(profile.volunteerGender || "—");
        $("#profile_birth").text(formatTime(profile.volunteerBirth).substring(0, 10));

        $("#profile_credit").text((profile.volunteerCredit === null || profile.volunteerCredit === undefined)
            ? "—" : profile.volunteerCredit);
        $("#profile_noshow").text((profile.volunteerNoshow === null || profile.volunteerNoshow === undefined)
            ? "—" : profile.volunteerNoshow);
        $("#profile_duration").text(formatHours(profile.volunteerTotalDuration));
        $("#profile_star").text(profile.starLevel || "—");

        var skills = profile.skills || [];
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 534 页
        $(".skill-checkbox").each(function () {
            $(this).prop("checked", $.inArray($(this).val(), skills) >= 0);
        });

        if (hasLocation(profile.latitude, profile.longitude)) {
            $("#profile_latitude").val(profile.latitude);
            $("#profile_longitude").val(profile.longitude);
            $("#saved_location").text("纬度 " + profile.latitude + "，经度 " + profile.longitude);
        } else {
            $("#profile_latitude").val("");
            $("#profile_longitude").val("");
            $("#saved_location").text("未设置");
        }
    }

    function loadProfile() {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/profile",
            type: "GET",
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.profile) {
                    if (result && result.msg) {
                        alert(result.msg);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                renderProfile(result.extend.profile);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
            }
        });
    }

    function fillLocation() {
        if (!navigator.geolocation) {
            alert("当前浏览器不支持定位，请手动填写常住坐标");
            return;
        }
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function (position) {
            $("#profile_latitude").val(position.coords.latitude);
            $("#profile_longitude").val(position.coords.longitude);
        }, function () {
            alert("未能获取当前位置，请检查浏览器定位权限后重试");
        }, {enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000, maximumAge: 0});
    }

    function saveProfile() {
        var skills = $(".skill-checkbox:checked").map(function () {
            return $(this).val();
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 535 页
        }).get().join(",");
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/profile/save",
            type: "POST",
            data: {
                skills: skills,
                latitude: $.trim($("#profile_latitude").val()),
                longitude: $.trim($("#profile_longitude").val())
            },
            success: function (result) {
                alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "操作完成");
                if (result && result.code === 100) {
                    loadProfile();
                }
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    function changePassword() {
        var oldPassword = $("#old_password").val();
        var newPassword = $("#new_password").val();
        var confirmPassword = $("#confirm_password").val();
        if (!oldPassword) {
            alert("请输入原密码");
            return;
        }
        if (!newPassword || newPassword.length < 8 || newPassword.length > 20) {
            alert("新密码长度需为 8~20 位");
            return;
        }
        if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
            alert("两次输入的新密码不一致");
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/password/change",
            type: "POST",
            data: {oldPassword: oldPassword, newPassword: newPassword},
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100) {
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "密码修改失败，请稍后重试");
                    return;
                }
                $("#old_password").val("");
                $("#new_password").val("");
                $("#confirm_password").val("");
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 536 页
                alert("密码已修改，请重新登录");
                window.location.href = "/logout";
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

            url: "/volunteer/content/show/publish",
            type: "POST",
            data: {detail: detail, activityNum: activityNum},
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100 || !result.extend || !result.extend.showNum) {
                    $("#btn_publish_show").prop("disabled", false);
                    alert((result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "志愿秀发布失败，请稍后重试");
                    return;
                }
                var msg = result.msg ? result.msg : "志愿秀发布成功";
                if (files.length === 0) {
                    finishPublish(msg);
                    return;
                }
                uploadPicture(result.extend.showNum, files, 0, msg);
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                $("#btn_publish_show").prop("disabled", false);
                alert("网络异常，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    function uploadPicture(showNum, files, index, publishMsg) {
        if (index >= files.length) {
            finishPublish(publishMsg);
            return;
        }
        var formData = new FormData();
        formData.append("showNum", showNum);
        formData.append("file", files[index]);
        $.ajax({
            url: "/volunteer/content/show/picture",
            type: "POST",
            data: formData,
            processData: false,
            contentType: false,
            success: function (result) {
                if (!result || result.code !== 100) {
                    var failMsg = (result && result.msg) ? result.msg : "图片上传失败，请稍后重试";
                    finishPublish(publishMsg + "；" + failMsg);
                    return;
                }
                uploadPicture(showNum, files, index + 1, result.msg ? result.msg : publishMsg);
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 545 页
            },
            error: function (result) {
                console.log(result);
                finishPublish(publishMsg + "；图片上传失败，请稍后重试");
            }
        });
    }

    function finishPublish(msg) {
        $("#btn_publish_show").prop("disabled", false);
        alert(msg);
        resetShowForm();
        showPage = 1;
        loadShows();
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        loadProfile();
        loadActivityOptions();
        loadShows();
    });
</script>

    function formatTime(value) {
        if (!value) {
            return "—";
        }
        return String(value).replace("T", " ").substring(0, 16);
    }

    function formatTrainingTime(training) {
        var begin = formatTime(training.trainingBegintime);
        var end = formatTime(training.trainingEndtime);
        if (begin === "—" && end === "—") {
            return "—";
        }
        return begin + " ~ " + end;
    }

    function renderPager(prefix, total, current, pageSize, defaultSize) {
        var totalCount = Number(total);
        if (isNaN(totalCount) || totalCount < 0) {
            totalCount = 0;
        }
        var currentPage = Number(current);
        if (isNaN(currentPage) || currentPage < 1) {
            currentPage = 1;
        }
        var currentSize = Number(pageSize);
        if (isNaN(currentSize) || currentSize < 1) {
            currentSize = defaultSize;
        }
        var totalPages = totalCount > 0 ? Math.ceil(totalCount / currentSize) : 1;
        $("#" + prefix + "_total").text("共 " + totalCount + " 条");
        $("#" + prefix + "_page_info").text("第 " + currentPage + " / " + totalPages + " 页");
        $("#" + prefix + "_prev").toggleClass("disabled", currentPage <= 1);
        $("#" + prefix + "_next").toggleClass("disabled", totalCount === 0 || currentPage >= totalPages);
        return totalCount;
    }

源码文件 180：src/test/java/com/evolunteer/entity/ApiResponseTest.java（单元测试）

package com.evolunteer.entity;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.List;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertSame;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class ApiResponseTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("成功结果的状态码与提示信息正确")
    void successShouldCarrySuccessCode() {
        ApiResponse response = ApiResponse.success();

        assertEquals(100, response.getCode());
        assertEquals("处理成功！", response.getMsg());
        assertTrue(response.getExtend().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("失败结果的状态码与提示信息正确")
    void failShouldCarryFailCode() {
        ApiResponse response = ApiResponse.fail();

        assertEquals(200, response.getCode());
        assertEquals("处理失败！", response.getMsg());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("添加业务数据后可被读取且支持连续追加")
    void addShouldStoreBusinessData() {
        List<String> activities = List.of("社区爱心助学志愿活动", "敬老院陪伴志愿服务");

        ApiResponse response = ApiResponse.success().add("auditActivity", activities).add("total", activities.size());

        assertSame(activities, response.getExtend().get("auditActivity"));
        assertEquals(2, response.getExtend().get("total"));
    }
}

源码文件 181：src/test/java/com/evolunteer/enums/VolunteerStarEnumTest.java（单元测试）
================================================================================================
package com.evolunteer.enums;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;

class VolunteerStarEnumTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("按累计服务时长认定星级，边界值归属上一档")
    void ofShouldMatchStarThresholds() {
        assertEquals("未定级", VolunteerStarEnum.of(0D).getStarName());
        assertEquals("未定级", VolunteerStarEnum.of(99.9).getStarName());
        assertEquals("一星志愿者", VolunteerStarEnum.of(100D).getStarName());
        assertEquals("二星志愿者", VolunteerStarEnum.of(300D).getStarName());
        assertEquals("三星志愿者", VolunteerStarEnum.of(600D).getStarName());
        assertEquals("四星志愿者", VolunteerStarEnum.of(1000D).getStarName());
        assertEquals("五星志愿者", VolunteerStarEnum.of(1500D).getStarName());
        assertEquals("五星志愿者", VolunteerStarEnum.of(9999D).getStarName());
        assertEquals("未定级", VolunteerStarEnum.of(null).getStarName());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("计算距离下一星级还需的累计服务时长")
    void hoursToNextStarShouldReturnRemainingHours() {
        assertEquals(100D, VolunteerStarEnum.hoursToNextStar(0D));
        assertEquals(97D, VolunteerStarEnum.hoursToNextStar(3D), 0.001);
        assertEquals(0D, VolunteerStarEnum.hoursToNextStar(1500D));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("下一星级在已达最高星级时为空")
    void nextStarShouldBeNullForTopStar() {
        assertEquals(VolunteerStarEnum.ONE_STAR, VolunteerStarEnum.nextStar(99D));
        assertEquals(VolunteerStarEnum.FIVE_STAR, VolunteerStarEnum.nextStar(1200D));
        assertNull(VolunteerStarEnum.nextStar(1500D));
    }
}

package com.evolunteer.utils;

E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 556 页
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class CertificateCodeUtilTest {

    private static final String SECRET = "evolunteer-test-secret";

    @Test
    @DisplayName("校验码固定为 16 位大写十六进制字符串且可重复计算")
    void codeShouldBeStableHexString() {
        String code = CertificateCodeUtil.code(SECRET, "vol_00001", 3.0, 1);

        assertEquals(16, code.length());
        assertTrue(code.matches("[0-9A-F]{16}"));
        assertEquals(code, CertificateCodeUtil.code(SECRET, "vol_00001", 3.0, 1));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("累计时长或服务记录数变化时校验码随之变化")
    void codeShouldChangeWithServiceData() {
        String code = CertificateCodeUtil.code(SECRET, "vol_00001", 3.0, 1);

        assertNotEquals(code, CertificateCodeUtil.code(SECRET, "vol_00001", 3.5, 1));
        assertNotEquals(code, CertificateCodeUtil.code(SECRET, "vol_00001", 3.0, 2));
        assertNotEquals(code, CertificateCodeUtil.code(SECRET, "vol_00002", 3.0, 1));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("密钥不同时同一份服务数据的校验码不同，第三方无法伪造")
    void codeShouldDependOnSecret() {
        assertNotEquals(CertificateCodeUtil.code(SECRET, "vol_00001", 3.0, 1),
                CertificateCodeUtil.code("another-secret", "vol_00001", 3.0, 1));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("累计时长为空时按 0 小时计算且不抛出异常")
    void codeShouldTolerateNullDuration() {
        String code = CertificateCodeUtil.code(SECRET, "vol_00001", null, null);

        assertEquals(16, code.length());
        assertEquals(code, CertificateCodeUtil.code(SECRET, "vol_00001", 0D, 0));
    }
}

package com.evolunteer.utils;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class CsvExporterTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("导出内容带 UTF-8 字节序标记并使用回车换行分隔")
    void toCsvShouldWriteBomAndLineSeparator() {
        String csv = CsvExporter.toCsv(Arrays.asList("姓名", "时长"), Collections.singletonList(Arrays.asList("张三", "3.0")));

        assertTrue(csv.startsWith("\uFEFF"));
        assertEquals("\uFEFF姓名,时长\r\n张三,3.0\r\n", csv);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("包含逗号、引号与换行的字段按 RFC 4180 规则转义")
    void escapeShouldQuoteSpecialCharacters() {
        assertEquals("普通文本", CsvExporter.escape("普通文本"));
        assertEquals("\"含,逗号\"", CsvExporter.escape("含,逗号"));
        assertEquals("\"含\"\"引号\"", CsvExporter.escape("含\"引号"));
        assertEquals("\"含换行\n文本\"", CsvExporter.escape("含换行\n文本"));
        assertEquals("", CsvExporter.escape(null));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("空数据行只输出表头")
    void toCsvShouldHandleEmptyRows() {
        List<String> headers = Arrays.asList("活动编号", "活动名称");

        assertEquals("\uFEFF活动编号,活动名称\r\n", CsvExporter.toCsv(headers, Collections.emptyList()));
    }
}

package com.evolunteer.utils;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 558 页

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

class DateTimeParserTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("支持浏览器日期时间控件与历史日期格式")
    void parseShouldSupportMultiplePatterns() throws Exception {
        assertEquals("2026-10-18 09:00:00", format(DateTimeParser.parse("2026-10-18T09:00")));
        assertEquals("2026-10-18 09:00:00", format(DateTimeParser.parse("2026-10-18 09:00")));
        assertEquals("2026-10-18 09:00:00", format(DateTimeParser.parse("2026-10-18T09:00:00")));
        assertEquals("2026-10-18 00:00:00", format(DateTimeParser.parse("2026-10-18")));
        assertEquals("2026-10-18 00:00:00", format(DateTimeParser.parse("10/18/2026")));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("空白时间文本解析为空值，由存储过程校验必填")
    void parseShouldReturnNullForBlankText() {
        assertNull(DateTimeParser.parse(null));
        assertNull(DateTimeParser.parse(""));
        assertNull(DateTimeParser.parse("   "));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("非法时间文本抛出可展示给用户的异常")
    void parseShouldRejectInvalidText() {
        IllegalArgumentException exception = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> DateTimeParser.parse("2026年10月18日"));

        assertEquals(true, exception.getMessage().contains("时间格式不正确"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> DateTimeParser.parse("2026-13-40"));
    }

    private String format(Date date) {
        return new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss").format(date);
    }
}

package com.evolunteer.utils;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 559 页

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class MD5UtilTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("相同密码的摘要结果一致且为 32 位十六进制字符串")
    void encodeShouldReturnStableHexCode() {
        String encoded = MD5Util.encode("123456");

        assertEquals("e10adc3949ba59abbe56e057f20f883e", encoded);
        assertEquals(32, encoded.length());
        assertTrue(encoded.matches("[0-9a-f]{32}"));
        assertEquals(encoded, MD5Util.encode("123456"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("不同密码的摘要结果不同")
    void encodeShouldDifferForDifferentPasswords() {
        assertNotEquals(MD5Util.encode("123456"), MD5Util.encode("1234567"));
        assertNotEquals(MD5Util.encode("abc"), MD5Util.encode("中国志愿者"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("中文密码的摘要结果与字符集无关且长度固定")
    void encodeShouldSupportChinesePassword() {
        String encoded = MD5Util.encode("志愿者服务平台");

        assertEquals(32, encoded.length());
        assertEquals(encoded, MD5Util.encode("志愿者服务平台"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("空明文在计算摘要前由调用方校验")
    void encodeShouldRejectNullPassword() {
        assertThrows(NullPointerException.class, () -> MD5Util.encode(null));
    }
}

class PageSupportTest {

    @DisplayName("分页参数为空或非法时使用默认值，超过上限时按上限截断")
    void ofShouldNormalizePageParams() {
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 562 页
        assertEquals(1, PageSupport.of(null, null).getCurrent());
        assertEquals(10, PageSupport.of(null, null).getSize());

        assertEquals(10, PageSupport.of(-3, -1).getSize());
        assertEquals(3, PageSupport.of(3, 20).getCurrent());
        assertEquals(100, PageSupport.of(1, 9999).getSize());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("分页结果按固定字段装入统一响应")
    void toResponseShouldFillStandardFields() {
        Page<AuditLog> page = new Page<>(2, 10, 25);
        page.setRecords(Arrays.asList(new AuditLog(), new AuditLog()));

        ApiResponse response = PageSupport.toResponse(page);
        Map<String, Object> extend = response.getExtend();

        assertEquals(100, response.getCode());
        assertEquals(2, extend.get("list") instanceof java.util.List ? ((java.util.List<?>) extend.get("list")).size() : -1);
        assertEquals(25L, extend.get("total"));
        assertEquals(2L, extend.get("page"));
        assertEquals(10L, extend.get("size"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("检索关键字去空格，空串统一为 null")
    void normalizeKeywordShouldTrimAndBlankToNull() {
        assertEquals("助学", PageSupport.normalizeKeyword("  助学 "));
        assertNull(PageSupport.normalizeKeyword(""));
        assertNull(PageSupport.normalizeKeyword("   "));
        assertNull(PageSupport.normalizeKeyword(null));
    }
}

E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 563 页

源码文件 189：src/test/java/com/evolunteer/utils/SecurePasswordEncoderTest.java（单元测试）
================================================================================================
package com.evolunteer.utils;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class SecurePasswordEncoderTest {

    private final SecurePasswordEncoder passwordEncoder = new SecurePasswordEncoder();

    @Test
    @DisplayName("加盐摘要可以校验原始密码且密文格式带有算法与迭代次数")
    void encodeShouldProduceVerifiableCipher() {
        String encoded = passwordEncoder.encode("123456");

        assertTrue(encoded.startsWith("pbkdf2$120000$"));
        assertTrue(passwordEncoder.matches("123456", encoded));
        assertFalse(passwordEncoder.matches("1234567", encoded));
        assertFalse(passwordEncoder.matches("123456", encoded + "x"));
        assertFalse(passwordEncoder.matches(null, encoded));
        assertFalse(passwordEncoder.matches("123456", null));
    }
E志愿志愿者服务平台 V1.0                                                               第 564 页

    @Test
    @DisplayName("同一密码两次加密得到不同密文，避免撞库时批量识破相同密码")
    void encodeShouldUseRandomSalt() {
        String first = passwordEncoder.encode("123456");
        String second = passwordEncoder.encode("123456");

        assertNotEquals(first, second);
        assertTrue(passwordEncoder.matches("123456", first));
        assertTrue(passwordEncoder.matches("123456", second));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("历史 MD5 密文可以校验通过并需要进行升级")
    void matchesShouldSupportLegacyMd5Cipher() {
        String legacy = MD5Util.encode("123456");

        assertTrue(passwordEncoder.matches("123456", legacy));
        assertFalse(passwordEncoder.matches("654321", legacy));
        assertTrue(passwordEncoder.upgradeEncoding(legacy));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("加盐密文无需再次升级")
    void upgradeEncodingShouldSkipSaltedCipher() {
        assertFalse(passwordEncoder.upgradeEncoding(passwordEncoder.encode("123456")));
        assertFalse(passwordEncoder.upgradeEncoding(null));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("非法密文校验返回 false 而不抛出异常")
    void matchesShouldRejectMalformedCipher() {
        assertFalse(passwordEncoder.matches("123456", "pbkdf2$abc$notbase64$notbase64"));
        assertFalse(passwordEncoder.matches("123456", "unknown$format"));
        assertEquals("123456", "123456");
    }
}
